text: The subject Kiran Rehman holds account PK**ABPA****5563 which was opened on 31 January 2022. The subject is declared as a Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 30,000 per month. During the activity window from 3 August 2026 to 9 August 2026 the account recorded 15 credits totalling PKR 830,000 and 3 debits totalling PKR 784,000. All 15 credits arrived via interbank (IBFT) transfers from 14 distinct senders. The activity was flagged by Tazama on 9 August 2026, with the typology MULE-01 scoring 360 against a threshold of 300. Overall, the pattern of activity is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 472,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 2 transactions. PKR 312,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 1 transaction. Screening on 29 August 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse‑media lists. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
